_context.panel.groups.included: Heading of the group of AI sources that come with the Rerun plan (the Rerun credit).
_context.panel.default.change: Button that opens the picker to change the workspace default model.
_context.panel.default.via: {source} is the name of the connection the default model runs through.
_context.panel.default.stopped: {source} is the name of the broken connection.
_context.status.paused: Badge: the Rerun credit is paused.
_context.subtitle.apiKey: {provider} is a provider name such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
_context.planLimits.updatedAgo: {age} is a short duration already localized, such as 5m, 3h, 2d, or a short date.
_context.planLimits.used: {percent} is a percentage already formatted, such as 42%.
_context.planLimits.usedWithReset: {percent} is a percentage already formatted. {reset} says when the limit resets, already localized.
_context.meter.planLimit: Accessible label of a progress bar. {name} is the name of a plan window, such as 5-hour or Weekly.
_context.models.count: How many of the models of this connection the coworkers can use, for example 3 of 8.
_context.opencode.count: How many models of this catalog are switched on, for example 3 of 8 on.
_context.remove.fallBack.agents: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.fallBack.both: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.released.agents: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.released.both: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.chatgpt.setting.settings: Must match the label of the Settings menu in ChatGPT's own interface, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.setting.security: Must match the label of the Security section in ChatGPT's own settings, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.setting.deviceCode: Must match the label of the setting in ChatGPT's own security settings, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.adminMessage: A message the user copies and sends to their ChatGPT workspace admin. The quoted setting name must match ChatGPT's own label.
_context.chatgpt.stuck.expiredSelf: <link> points at ChatGPT's security settings; the path must match ChatGPT's own labels.
_context.chatgpt.stuck.errorSelf: <link> points at ChatGPT's security settings; the path must match ChatGPT's own labels.
_context.chatgpt.remarks.grabCode: Said by the Foreman, the assistant: now get a sign-in code.
_context.claude.remarks.checking: Said by the Foreman while the code is being checked; animated dots follow it.
_context.nameStep.title: Title of the last step: give the connection a name.
_context.custom.probe.unreachableCloud: {host} is a host name and port, such as localhost:11434.
_context.custom.probe.unreachableLocal: {host} is a host name and port, such as localhost:11434.
_context.custom.probe.refused: {model} is a model id. {detail} is the error the server sent back, in English.
_context.custom.probe.refusedUnnamedDetail: {detail} is the error the server sent back, in English.
_context.detail.readOnly: {reason} is a sentence without a final period that explains why the controls are disabled.
